# Great South America Tour 2027: Peru, Bolivia and Chile in 14 days

**Duration:** 14 days / 13 nights  
**Route:** Lima (2 nights) – Cusco (2 nights) – Puno (2 nights) – La Paz (2 nights) – Uyuni (2 nights) – San Pedro de Atacama (1 night) – Santiago de Chile (2 nights)  
**Optional extensions:** Easter Island, 3 days / 2 nights; the journey can also continue to Patagonia  
**Price:** from $6,559 per person

Discover the most beautiful places of South America in one trip. This tour through Peru, Bolivia and Chile takes you to Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca, the Uyuni Salt Flat and the Atacama Desert, magnificent natural wonders not to be missed, and to the fascinating cities of Lima, Cusco, Puno, La Paz and Santiago. And you can even extend your trip to Easter Island and its Moai.

Over 14 days, the route crosses Peru, Bolivia and Chile. You begin on the Pacific coast in Lima, climb into the Andes to Cusco and Machu Picchu, travel via Lake Titicaca and La Paz to the Uyuni Salt Flat and Bolivia’s high-altitude lagoons, cross into Chile through the Atacama and finish in Santiago.

The journey brings constant changes in altitude and scenery. Lima’s colonial quarters give way to Inca stone monuments, the cold waters of Titicaca, the dry Altiplano, the white expanse of Uyuni, coloured lagoons with flamingos and the desert landscapes around San Pedro de Atacama. The final days are spent in green Santiago beneath the Andes.

Easter Island is available as a separate extension. Its programme includes the archaeological sites of Rapa Nui, Rano Raraku volcano, Ahu Tongariki, Anakena beach, the ceremonial village of Orongo and Ahu Akivi.

Peru offers three different encounters with the Andes: Cusco’s imperial history, Machu Picchu above the Urubamba Valley and the cold waters of Titicaca with the floating Uros Islands. In Bolivia, the road climbs higher into increasingly arid scenery. La Paz lies in a deep canyon; Uyuni opens onto an almost endless salt flat; farther south are lagoons, volcanoes, geysers and the Siloli Desert. In Chile, the route reaches San Pedro de Atacama before a flight down to Santiago.

Private services and an English-speaking guide are available at an additional cost. The specific hotel is confirmed at the time of booking.

## Optional extension: Easter Island, 3 days / 2 nights

You can add Easter Island to the main journey.

The island is home to the famous moai, carved from volcanic rock. Some statues reach 10 m in height. The moai are associated with the Rapa Nui people’s ancestor worship. The island was once covered in palm forests, but as the population grew, trees were cut down faster than the forest could regenerate. The soil gradually became depleted and the landscape more open. Against this backdrop, the giant stone figures, standing in the wind and the sound of the ocean, are particularly striking.

The island programme takes in several archaeological areas and natural sites.
